DASHBOARD._header: Data and services to anticipate climate emergencies
DASHBOARD._subheader: Discover, compare and consume meteorological, hydrological and environmental data published by the organisations of the PGTEC data space, under clear and verifiable terms of use.
DASHBOARD._search_ph: Search meteorological or hydrological data, providers...

landing._search_hint: Type to filter the categories below, or open the full list of services.
landing._about_title: A single access point to data for climate emergency prevention
landing._about_text: The PGTEC Marketplace is the catalogue of the data space. Member organisations publish meteorological, hydrological and environmental data and services here, so others can discover, compare and consume them through the data space connector.
landing._benefit1_text: Every organisation joins with a digital identifier and verifiable credentials, so you always know who stands behind each offering.
landing._benefit2_text: Every asset carries the terms of use set by its provider, within the common Governance Framework of the data space.
landing._benefit3_text: Data and services built on FIWARE open standards, ready to plug into early-warning and emergency management systems.
landing._provider_text: Publish data and services in the catalogue, set their terms of use and keep control over your assets. If your organisation is not part of the data space yet, request to join.
